title: RV & Boat Storage Rental Terms — Eligibility, Reservation and Move-In
content:
These clauses of the RV & Boat Storage rental terms govern who may rent a space, what the unit must meet, how a reservation holds a space and is cancelled, and what is charged at move-in.

**1. Residents only.** Holding a site lease is a condition of renting storage: storage is rented only to residents. The renter holds an active Hearthstone site lease in the community whose yard the space is in.

1.1 This is decided before the reservation is taken, from the company's own site-lease records — the lease, the customer who holds it, its status and the community it is in — not from the customer's statement. The reservation is tied to that lease: the lease recorded on the reservation is the active site lease that satisfies this clause.

1.2 Hypothetical cases. A resident whose active site lease is at Saguaro Vista may reserve a space in the Saguaro Vista yard. The same resident does not meet clause 1 for a space in the Bluebonnet Ridge yard, because the active lease is not in the community whose yard the space is in. A customer whose only site lease is not active does not meet clause 1 in any yard.

**2. The unit.** The unit must meet the space class's entry gate (unit type, length and height) and, before move-in, proof of insurance and current registration must be on file and the unit must be operable or road-towable.

2.1 A reservation records the unit to be stored: its type, its overall length in feet, and its license plate or hull registration as shown on its registration, together with the space class and the space number as posted in the yard (for example RV-23).

**3. Reservation deposit and hold.** The reservation deposit is collected when reserving and holds the space for the reservation hold period of the space class; a reservation not moved in within that time is cancelled.

**4. Cancelling a reservation.** A cancelled reservation's deposit is refunded only when the cancellation is received no later than the refund window's number of calendar days after the reservation date; otherwise it is forfeited.

4.1 The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the reservation date, and a cancellation on the last day is refunded. The reservation date is the one on the company's record of that storage rental; the cancellation is matched to that same rental. The number of days is the reservation refund window set for the space class.

4.2 Boundary cases (hypothetical reservation date 10 March, with a 3-day window):

| Cancellation received | Day of the window | Reservation deposit |
|---|---|---|
| 12 March | second day | refunded |
| 13 March | last day | refunded |
| 14 March | after the window | forfeited |

4.3 Cancelling is the resident's act on a reservation before moving in, and the cancellation closes the rental.

**5. Move-in charges.** At move-in the administration fee and the security deposit are charged, the first month's rent is prorated on the move-in proration basis of the space class (the actual days in the month), and the reservation deposit is applied to that first month's rent.

5.1 Move-in starts the rental: the rental becomes active on the move-in date, which is also the date of the first month's rent charge, the administration fee and the security deposit.
